main.description: Summarize one community's classification results over the last seven days for one question: per kind, how many posts and comments were scored and how many of them have a most recent probability at or above minProbability, plus the community's NSFW flag changes in the same window. Results under any evaluation count. Probabilities and the share are integer parts per million. Admin identity comes from the authenticated service context, never request fields.

question.description: Policy question key of the current policy

minProbability.description: Probability in parts per million at or above which a subject counts as above

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; authenticate with an instance administrator's service account before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The authenticated actor is not an instance administrator; do not retry.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: community, question or minProbability is missing or invalid, or question is not in the current policy; correct the request before retrying.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community has this DID; do not retry.

since.description: Inclusive start of the window on the result's createdAt

until.description: Exclusive end of the window on the result's createdAt

share.description: (posts.above + comments.above) / (posts.scored + comments.scored) in parts per million; absent when nothing was scored

flagEvents.description: The community's NSFW flag changes in the window, newest first

kindSummary.description: Counts for one kind of subject

scored.description: Distinct subjects with a result in the window

above.description: Scored subjects whose most recent result in the window is at or above minProbability for the question

flagEvent.description: One change of the community's NSFW flag

delivered.description: Whether the operator alert for this change has been sent; false while it is pending or after its sends failed at the attempt limit.
